name: Bank of America Travel Rewards Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Trip delay insurance is not a standard benefit on the Bank of America Travel Rewards card. Basic travel and emergency assistance services are included via Visa Signature.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance is not a standard benefit. Visa Signature travel assistance is available.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance may be included via Visa Signature benefits. Coverage details vary.

emergencyMedical.notes: Emergency assistance services available via Visa Signature hotline for referrals; does not cover medical costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver via Visa Signature — secondary coverage. Decline the rental company's CDW.

rewards.travelRate: 1.5x (same flat rate — no bonus for travel category)

pointValue.transferPartners: No transfer partners. Points redeemable as statement credit toward travel purchases at 1 cent per point.

travelPerks: 1.5x points on every purchase — no rotating categories
Points redeemable as statement credit for any travel purchase
Preferred Rewards bonus: 25-75% more points for BofA banking customers
Visa Signature travel and emergency assistance services
No expiration on points as long as account is open
bestFor: Simple, no-fee travelers who want a flat 1.5x rate on everything with no foreign transaction fees
